about: SA-X31, Eden's music kinds (#2921). An instrument played in place (a piano, a keyboard, a music stand, a drum kit, a guitar stool) or a microphone is taken up by one Soul at a time (its player or singer link) while it is silent, at a tune by mood (play, play_happy, play_sad; sing, ...), and only that Soul stops it; a drum kit and a guitar stool also need their seat free. A guitar or a bass is played while held with the other hand free, and a stand gives its instrument into a free hand and takes it back into its cradle. A speaker is switched on and off at its switch with a free hand. Each case is one need unmet, or none.
